verdict.rationale: Any service that collects and holds user data, including a government business-registry portal, could plausibly state a policy on AI-training use, so this privacy axis applies. The evidence pack only covers filings, registrations, certificates, notifications and records retrieval. Nothing mentions AI-training data use, an opt-out, or a data-use policy, so the verdict is none.
